name: egg-tools
description: Claude Code plugins distributed from the egg repository. Each plugin packages one of egg's local skills (refine-plan, etc.) for install via the Claude Code plugin system.

plugins.name: refine-plan
plugins.description: BRC-inspired local approximation of egg's refine + plan phases: role-typed subagents, evidence-backed iterated parallel review, per-cycle verdict journal, artifacts consistent with egg's .egg-state/ layout. Not a real BRC bus — see SKILL.md for the honest framing.
